Engelsk (reference):
1. The service

GymMarket is operated by {co_name}, Danish CVR {co_cvr}, {co_address} (email: {co_email}). GymMarket is a listing platform. Transactions are concluded directly between buyer and seller. GymMarket is not a party to the transaction and is not liable for the condition, safety or delivery of the equipment.

2. Users

  • To create listings and wanted ads you need an account with a confirmed email.
  • Information must be accurate. Traders must provide company name, address and registration number.
  • Clubs, schools and companies can be verified by GymMarket using the number from their country's official register. GymMarket may refuse or revoke a verification.

3. Listings

  • Listings must describe the item accurately, including defects and wear.
  • When importing a listing from Facebook, the seller confirms that it is the seller's own listing and that the seller has the right to use the text and photos.
  • A listing is active for a fixed number of days and can then be renewed.
  • GymMarket may remove listings that are illegal, unsafe or misleading. The seller is notified with a statement of reasons.

4. Price

Using GymMarket is free. If fees are introduced later, you will be notified at least 30 days in advance.

5. Reporting content

Anyone can report a listing. Reports are handled promptly and objectively.

6. Safety

Buyers should always inspect the item before paying. Used equipment should be checked by a qualified person before use.

7. Governing law

Danish law. Consumers keep the rights granted by the law of their country of residence.
Dansk (reference):
1. Tjenesten

GymMarket drives af {co_name}, CVR {co_cvr}, {co_address} (e-mail: {co_email}). GymMarket er en annonceplatform. Handler indgås direkte mellem køber og sælger. GymMarket er ikke part i handlen og hæfter ikke for redskabernes stand, sikkerhed eller levering.

2. Brugere

  • For at oprette annoncer og efterlysninger skal du have en bruger med bekræftet e-mail.
  • Oplysningerne skal være korrekte. Erhvervsdrivende skal oplyse virksomhedsnavn, adresse og registreringsnummer.
  • Foreninger, skoler og virksomheder kan blive verificeret af GymMarket med nummeret fra det officielle register i deres land. GymMarket kan afvise eller tilbagekalde en verificering.

3. Annoncer

  • Annoncen skal beskrive redskabet retvisende, også fejl og slitage.
  • Importeres en annonce fra Facebook, bekræfter sælger, at det er sælgers egen annonce, og at sælger har ret til at bruge tekst og billeder.
  • En annonce er aktiv i et fast antal dage og kan derefter fornyes.
  • GymMarket kan fjerne annoncer, der er ulovlige, farlige eller vildledende. Sælger får besked med begrundelse.

4. Pris

Det er gratis at bruge GymMarket. Hvis der senere indføres betaling, varsles det mindst 30 dage i forvejen.

5. Anmeldelse af indhold

Alle kan anmelde en annonce. Anmeldelser behandles hurtigt og objektivt.

6. Sikkerhed

Køber bør altid se redskabet før betaling. Brugte redskaber skal efterses af en kyndig person, før de tages i brug.

7. Lovvalg

Dansk ret. Forbrugere bevarer de rettigheder, de har efter lovgivningen i deres bopælsland.

Controller

{co_name}, Danish CVR {co_cvr}, {co_address}. Email: {co_email}.

What data?

Account: name, email, password (encrypted), user type, organisation name, country and optional phone. For verification also country, number type and registration number, and for EU VAT numbers the result of a lookup in the EU's VIES register. For traders company name, address and registration number. Also the content and photos of your listings.

Purpose and legal basis

To provide your account and display your listings (GDPR Art. 6(1)(b)) and to comply with EU marketplace rules (Art. 6(1)(c)). Name, email and phone are shown on your listings.

Retention

Listings are deleted 12 months after expiry or sale. Your account and data are deleted on request.

Processors

Data is stored with a hosting provider and database in the EU.

Cookies

No tracking cookies. The browser's local storage is used for your language and to keep you logged in.

Your rights

You have the right of access, rectification, erasure and data portability. Write to {co_email}. You may complain to your national data protection authority.
